info.title: Universal Scheduling Protocol (USP) MCP API
info.description: The Universal Scheduling Protocol (USP) MCP binding uses JSON-RPC 2.0 for AI agents that interact with USP via tool calls. MCP clients invoke USP operations via the standard MCP tools/call method, with params.name set to the method name defined here and params.arguments containing the operation parameters. Each method maps to a corresponding REST operation. Responses use the structuredContent/content dual-envelope pattern.

methods.name: usp_services_list
methods.description: Returns a filtered, paginated list of services from the business catalog. Maps to POST /services/list.

params.name: _meta

profile.description: Platform profile URI for capability negotiation. The business fetches this document to determine the capability intersection. REQUIRED in Standalone Mode.

params.description: MCP metadata. The usp.profile field carries the platform profile URI for capability negotiation (Standalone Mode). Required in Standalone Mode; omit in UCP-Native Mode.

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text search query across service names, descriptions, and categories. When present, the business SHOULD rank results by relevance. Businesses that do not support search MUST ignore this field.

schema.description: Filter criteria to narrow results. All specified filters combine with AND logic.

category_id.description: Single category ID. Shorthand for categories with one value. If both provided, categories takes precedence.

categories.description: Category IDs to filter by (OR logic).

price.description: Price range filter in minor currency units.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units.

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units.

params.name: context

schema.description: Buyer locale and intent signals for relevance, localization, and personalization. Aligns with UCP context pattern.

coordinates.description: Buyer's geographic coordinates for proximity-based ranking.

language.description: Preferred language (IETF BCP 47, e.g., en, fr-CA).

intent.description: Free-text buyer intent (e.g., 'looking for a relaxing spa treatment').

params.description: Buyer locale and intent signals. Businesses SHOULD use when available and MUST ignore unrecognized fields.

messages.description: Optional errors, warnings, or informational messages about the response.

content.description: Human-readable text summary for MCP clients that render text.

params.description: Service IDs to look up. Businesses MUST accept at least 50 IDs. Duplicates are silently deduplicated.

methods.name: usp_availability_query
methods.description: Returns available time slots for a service within a date range. Maps to POST /availability/query. Platforms SHOULD query at most 7 calendar days per request. Businesses MAY reject wider ranges with error code range_too_wide. Slots are returned in ascending start order.

params.name: _meta

profile.description: Platform profile URI for capability negotiation. The business fetches this document to determine the capability intersection. REQUIRED in Standalone Mode.

params.description: MCP metadata. The usp.profile field carries the platform profile URI for capability negotiation (Standalone Mode). Required in Standalone Mode; omit in UCP-Native Mode.

schema.description: Start of range (RFC 3339 date or datetime).
End of range (RFC 3339 date or datetime).
IANA timezone. Defaults to business timezone.
Preferred resource. If provided, only slots where this resource is available are returned.
Number of participants. For group/reservation types, only slots with sufficient remaining capacity are returned.
Location filter. Only slots at this location are returned. Applies to multi-location businesses.
BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US). When provided, the business SHOULD return human-readable content (resource names, slot labels, opening_hours day names) in the requested locale.
Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit on the first request.
Requested page size. Businesses MAY apply a lower or upper cap.

opening_hours.description: Regular business hours for the queried period. Special closures are reflected by the absence of slots, not by this field.

day_of_week.description: Days this entry applies to. Lowercase English day names.

opens.description: Opening time in HH:MM 24-hour format (local business time).

closes.description: Closing time in HH:MM 24-hour format (local business time). 00:00 or 24:00 indicates midnight (end of day).

messages.description: Optional informational or warning messages about the result set.

content.description: Human-readable text summary for MCP clients that render text.

params.name: recipient
params.description: The person receiving the service, when different from the buyer. When absent, the buyer is the recipient.

params.name: post_payment_return_request
params.description: Applicable when checkout_systems: redirect is in use. The platform SHOULD always include this field on the redirect checkout path — without it, the platform has no way to predict where the buyer will land after payment or cancellation/abandonment. If present, the business MUST redirect the buyer's browser (via GET) to the specified URL with the specified query parameters appended after payment completes, is cancelled, or is abandoned.
